QuestInfo.name: [Homecoming] Chilly Down
QuestInfo.0: Gaga needs your help for Homecoming.
QuestInfo.1: Hold on to the Sports Drink you got from Gaga for 30 minutes to turn it into a Frozen Sports Drink. #bRemember: the drink will evaporate if you log out before then!
QuestInfo.2: Everybody freeze! Your drinks, that is.

0.0: Hi #b#h0##k! Are you feeling extra super sporty? Everybody gets... sort of terrifyingly competitive when Homecoming comes around. I figured the best way to avoid some wedgies was to give out the goods! Would you be willing to help me out?

yes.0: The best way to keep jocks out of your drawers is to get them some nice refreshments! I whipped up a bunch of delicious drinks... but they're not cold! You would not believe how hard it is to find a decent refrigerator in Maple World.
yes.1: I put a very special freeze powder in the jug. If you just hold on to that Sports Drink for #b30 minutes#k, it'll turn into a #bFrozen Sports Drink#k! That powder is super crazy strong though, so it'll #rdisappear if you log out#k.

no.0: Okay, I'll go get my iron undies on and hole up for the rest of the week.

default.0: That's not looking terribly frozen to me.
